newsitem.title: HONG KONG: HK's Nan Fung Finance sets HK$400 mln loan.
newsitem.headline: HK's Nan Fung Finance sets HK$400 mln loan.

text.p: BNP Hong Kong said on Thursday it is inviting banks to join a HK$400 million term loan facility for Nan Fung Finance Ltd.
The facility, for which BNP Hong Kong is the sole arranger, is guaranteed by the borrower's parent, Nan Fung Textiles Consolidated Ltd.
The loan has a maturity of three years with an annual put option. It pays a margin of 60 basis points over the Hong Kong Interbank Offered Rate.
With fees, the all-in return for top-tier managers is in the low-70s over HIBOR.
Proceed of the loan will be used for general working capital.
Replies are due at the end of March.
